uT: its result is passed under the key charging of a new crystal's state; true while this.prepared or this.round is set
vT: getSnapshot() stores its result under the key beamTiles; the tiles of the charging round's lines
pT: getSnapshot() stores its result under the key beamFiredTiles; the tiles of the round fired on the given tick
kT: inferred: sets this.readyTick to the tick unless it is already set; called when a crystal is spawned
ST: it sets state.charging = true on each crystal
bT: it makes this.round ({ chargeTick, fireTick, lines }) from this.prepared once prepared.chargeTick is reached; the encounter plays clipId "charge" for its result
yT: inferred: clears round, prepared, fired and hitTick, keeps a readyTick and sets the crystals' state.charging false; called while mechanics.solHereditBeams is false
zT: inferred: readyTick = min(readyTick, tick) when no round is active; called when the enrage phase begins
wT: at round.fireTick it moves the round into this.fired and sets hitTick; the encounter plays clipId "attack" and the "fire" graphics for its result
LT: returns the damage with source "SolLightBeam" once this.hitTick is reached
AT: inferred: added to the fire tick to make this.readyTick; 5 in the enrage phase, otherwise a random value from 22 to 29

WT: getSnapshot() stores its result under the key sandTiles; the keys of this.pools as [x, y]
RT: inferred: empties this.pending and deletes the pools formed on or after the given tick; called when Sol is defeated
PT: inferred: this.pools has the tile's key; nothing calls it

fT: inferred: the route position a number of ticks after the first step (this.start for a negative number); it gives the orb's path step and its spawn position

DT: returns the actors of the "colosseum-warbander" definition; a noun to match orbs() and bees()
HT: returns the actors of the "colosseum-healing-totem" definition; a noun to match orbs() and bees()
MT: inferred: for selection.totemic it spawns the totem ("sol_totem_N") once this.totemDue is reached and updates the totems; it despawns them when the boss is not alive
TT: inferred: despawns every totem and sets this.totemDue back to "half-hp"; called from enterBossHpPhase()
IT: inferred: runs the respawn step (state.teleportAt, state.resumeAt) for every bee swarm
CT: it calls despawnNpc for every bee swarm and warbander; called on deathCleanupTick
xT: inferred: true until this.removeOrbsAt is reached; it gates the movement of the solarflare orbs
BT: inferred: sets this.removeOrbsAt (tick + 11) and, for selection.volatility, this.explosion (tick + 9); called when "sol_heredit" is defeated

_T: getSnapshot() stores its length under the key crystalCount; the alive actors of the "colosseum-beam-crystal" definition, sorted by state.index
FT: inferred: mechanics.solHereditAttacks is false or Sol can launch from its position; the same condition (launched || !enabled) prepares the beams later in the tick
ET: it raises this.phase, says the phase's taunt and pushes the "sand" and "crystal" entries of this.pendingTransitions
NT: it takes the due entries of this.pendingTransitions (kind "sand" or "crystal")
GT: it strikes sand once this.nextEnrageSandTick is reached and sets the next one
UT: inferred: resolves the beam hit, starts the charge and fires the round with their "colosseum_visual"; cancels the round when mechanics.solHereditBeams is false
jT: returns the "overhead_text" event of a grapple taunt, with overheadTextColor and overheadTextSegments
OT: the command case "spawn-crystal" calls it; it calls spawnNpc with id "sol_crystal_N"
$T: added to the tick to make this.nextEnrageSandTick; a random value from 6 to 8
VT: returns an event of type "overhead_text" anchored to the actor "sol_heredit"
KT: it emits the sand strike's "colosseum_visual" unless mechanics.solHereditSand is false
